description: 等待 Ant Design 表格加载完成（出现 tr.ant-table-row 或 .ant-empty），返回 rowCount / headers / isEmpty。

steps.expression: (() => { const scope = document.querySelector('{{scopeSelector}}') || document; const rows = scope.querySelectorAll('tr.ant-table-row'); if (rows.length > 0) return true; const empty = scope.querySelector('.ant-empty'); if (empty) return true; const spinning = scope.querySelector('.ant-spin-spinning'); if (spinning) return false; return true; })()

(() => { const scope = document.querySelector('{{scopeSelector}}') || document; const rows = scope.querySelectorAll('tr.ant-table-row'); const ths = Array.from(scope.querySelectorAll('th, .ant-table-thead th')); const empty = scope.querySelector('.ant-empty'); return { scope: '{{scopeSelector}}', rowCount: rows.length, isEmpty: !!empty, headers: ths.slice(0, 20).map(th => (th.textContent || '').trim()) }; })()
